seo.title: Security — Qarote RabbitMQ Monitoring
seo.description: How Qarote handles your data: TLS by default, no message payloads stored, explicit AI data residency, offline self-hosting, and SOC 2 on Enterprise.

hero.title: Built to read your broker, not your data.
hero.subtitle: Qarote connects to RabbitMQ over TLS, reads only management and metrics data, and never stores your message payloads. Here's exactly what that means.

encryption.title: Encryption in transit
encryption.body: Connections to your RabbitMQ broker use TLS by default. Qarote talks to the Management HTTP API over an encrypted channel — no plaintext broker traffic.

noStore.title: What we read — and don't store
noStore.body: Qarote reads only metrics and management data from the Management HTTP API. We do not store:
items: Message payloads — never read or stored
noStore.note: Only configuration and alert/notification preferences are persisted.

residency.heading: You choose where AI Explain runs.
residency.body: Root-cause analysis can run three ways. The choice determines whether any data leaves your network — and self-hosters can keep everything in-network.

rows.name: Managed cloud · Qarote key
rows.detail: The incident plus surrounding broker state is sent to Qarote's managed LLM provider using our key. Simplest to run — zero configuration.

rows.name: BYOK · your Anthropic / OpenAI key
rows.detail: Analysis runs on your own model provider account with your API key. Data goes to your chosen provider under your terms — not through Qarote's account.

rows.name: Local Ollama · self-hosted
rows.detail: Analysis runs on a local Ollama model on your own hardware. Nothing leaves your network — broker state never crosses your perimeter.

selfHost.title: Self-host & data control
selfHost.body: Run Qarote entirely inside your own infrastructure. All data stays within your network, and licenses validate offline — there is no phone-home, no telemetry beacon, and no dependency on our uptime for yours.
items: Local Ollama for fully in-network AI

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.body: SOC 2 is available on the Enterprise plan. If your procurement process needs a report, security review, or DPA, our team can walk you through it.

disclosure.heading: Responsible disclosure
disclosure.body: Found a vulnerability? We want to hear from you. Email security@qarote.io with details and steps to reproduce. We'll acknowledge your report, keep you updated, and credit you once it's resolved. Please give us a reasonable window to fix issues before public disclosure.

cta.heading: Questions about security?
cta.body: Our team is happy to walk through data handling, residency, and compliance for your environment.
